notes: Probes: 'el grito' 0.52 (' g'), 'un gato' 0.64 (' g'), 'delegado gremial' 0.59 (' g'), 'agricultural/gardening' 0.62 ('/g'); 'at Gombe' 0.28 (peak elsewhere); '5 g of salt' 0.002; whole-token 'garden' 0.001; 'humilde' 0.10.
